correctness.rationale: The four simple rational poles x=0,±1,infinity have Artin–Schreier different exponent4, so 2g-2=3(-2)+4(4)=10 and g=6. For any 3∤n, translation x->x+t changes f(x) by t, hence exactly one of three translated field elements has trace zero; with four rational branch points this proves #X(F_{3^n})=3^n+1 for every such n. Independently constructed GF(3^n) polynomial fields, checked irreducibility and exhaustively counted all x and y-solutions (using trace criterion) for n1–6: N=[4,10,76,82,244,670]. The resulting S=[0,0,-48,0,0,60], Newton identities produce first half coefficients 1,0,0,16,0,0,118; genus-six Weil functional symmetry gives complete L. Direct integer multiplication verifies (1-T+3T²)²(1+T-2T²+3T³+9T⁴)², L(1)=1296. Quartic Weil reciprocal is irreducible over Q by integer quadratic-factor comparison; nonzero ordinary middle coefficient yields simple ordinary surface and F3 isogeny decomposition.
